---
name: Bug report
about: Report a problem with the runtime, catalog, website, or documentation.
---

Thanks for reporting a problem. Share what you know; you can leave any section
blank if you do not have the information.

## Affected area

Runtime, catalog sound/controller, website, or documentation? Include the sound
name or page if relevant.

## What happened?

Describe the problem.

## Expected behavior

What did you expect to happen?

## Steps to reproduce

Include a small code example or a sequence of actions if possible. For sound
issues, include the recipe, parameters, and seed when relevant.

## Runtime and browser information

AudioBits version, browser/version, and operating system, if known. For setup or
build problems, include Node and package-manager versions if relevant.

## Logs or screenshots (optional)

Add helpful console output, screenshots, or a recording. Remove private details.
For sound-quality reports, describe what you heard and your listening setup
separately from test results.
